name: William Knowles
biography: William Knowles is a Security Consultant at MWR InfoSecurity. He is primarily involved in purple team activities, which involves objective-based testing to simulate real-world threats, and helping organizations to identify effective defenses against them with regards to both prevention and detection. Prior to joining the security industry, he completed a PhD in Computer Science at Lancaster University. His research interests include post-exploitation activities and offensive PowerShell. @william_knows
